title: Regulatory Notice: Clean Sample Rounds Confirmed — Advisory Lift Initiation

fields.office: Division of Drinking and Ground Waters, Central District
fields.subject: Confirmation of Clean Sample Rounds — Advisory Lift Initiation
fields.applicability: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer, all personnel involved in advisory management and water quality reporting
fields.purpose:
The Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District has verified two consecutive clean sample rounds from Zone 1 (Sample 24-1189 and 24-1190) confirming pH at 7.8 and caustic dose at 4.0 mg/L — both within safe drinking water standards. The control system remains isolated and under forensic review. The advisory lift process is now authorized under ERP Section 11.3.

The City must proceed with verification and public release only after final confirmation from the Water Quality Manager and Public Information Officer. The Ohio EPA will conduct a follow-up compliance review within 72 hours of advisory lift initiation to ensure full adherence to state and federal standards.
actions: Submit the final lab report (24-1190) to the DDAGW-ELR-2026 electronic reporting portal within 4 hours.
Confirm advisory lift initiation with the Water Quality Manager and Public Information Officer prior to any public communication.
Initiate the MillbrookAlert broadcast for advisory lift, using the approved messaging template from Section 11.3.
Notify the Carver County EOC and OHWARN mutual-aid partners of the advisory lift status.
Preserve all field logs, lab reports, and HMI screen captures for the 72-hour review window.
fields.contact: Questions: contact Carol Dugan, Ohio EPA DDAGW Central District, at (555) 037-1555 or carol.dugan@epa.ohio.gov

approvedBy.name: Carol Dugan
